speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing right groin pain and had to position your leg abnormally after a rear-end collision. Can you describe exactly how your leg was positioned when the pain started, and did you hear a snap or pop at the time of the accident?

speaker: Patient
text: 25-year-old female. The patient was involved in a rear-end collision where she was the restrained driver of the back car. She reports immediate onset of pain in both knees and severe pain over the right groin area following the accident.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acetabular Fracture with Posterior Dislocation.

I am concerned you have a hip fracture or dislocation given the mechanism of injury and immediate groin pain; can you tell me if you were able to move your right leg at all after the accident, and is the leg currently bent inward and rotated?
